nodes.name: src/client/bridge.rs
nodes.summary: VirtuosoClient TCP bridge to the Cadence Virtuoso daemon. Wraps the raw STX/NAK TCP protocol, drives SKILL execution with capability gating and an evalstring whitelist, exposes layout/schematic/maestro/window operation handles, and manages transactions and SSH tunneling.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the STX/ETX framed protocol; many methods assemble SKILL strings via the *_ops builders; capability + whitelist enforced on raw skill exec; transactions are stored in std::cell::RefCell (single-threaded client).

nodes.name: src/client/editor.rs
nodes.summary: Layout and Schematic editor builder structs (LayoutEditor, SchematicEditor) that collect SKILL commands into a batch and execute them as a single call.
nodes.languageNotes: Two zero-copy builders over VirtuosoClient; all unit structs use LayoutOps/SchematicOps for SKILL string generation.

nodes.name: src/client/layout_ops.rs
nodes.summary: LayoutOps SKILL string builder: rodCreateRect, rodCreatePolygon, rodCreatePath, rodCreateVia, rodCreateInstance, xstOutDoTranslate. XstreamOutRequest config struct for tape-out streaming.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure SKILL-string formatters backed by escape_skill_string; XstreamOutRequest is a borrowed &str struct; most ops are unit structs.

nodes.name: src/client/library_ops.rs
nodes.summary: LibraryOps read-only SKILL builder for ddGetLibList(). Tiny unit struct used by the library list command.
nodes.languageNotes: Single method returning a SKILL lambda string; used by commands/library.rs.

nodes.name: src/client/maestro_ops.rs
nodes.summary: MaestroOps builder for SKILL strings driving Cadence Maestro simulation setup (sessions, maeGetSetup, maeSetAnalysis, sweeps, ocean export). ExportWaveformRequest DTO for waveform export.
nodes.languageNotes: Long SKILL strings with embedded version-dependent branches (IC23 vs IC25); ExportWaveformRequest wraps file paths.

nodes.name: src/client/mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module index for the client submodule, exporting bridge, editor, layout_ops, library_ops, maestro_ops, schematic_ops, skill_loading (private), skill_runtime (pub(crate)), skill_sexp, symbol_ops, whitelist, window_ops.

nodes.name: src/client/schematic_ops.rs
nodes.summary: SchematicOps SKILL builders for instance creation, wire/instance deletion, property edits, and cellview save/commit. Prepends a cv_guard() that errors when no cellview is open.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses geGetEditCellView() rather than RB_SCH_CV for cv binding; cv_guard() forces explicit cellview open.

nodes.name: src/client/skill_runtime.rs
nodes.summary: Internal helpers for SKILL/JSON interop: escape_string, string_literal, require_identifier, require_transport, require_non_nil, decode_json, decode_json_payload.
nodes.languageNotes: pub(crate) helpers shared across commands/*; centralizes error mapping from VirtuosoResult to VirtuosoError.

nodes.name: src/client/skill_sexp.rs
nodes.summary: S-expression parser for SKILL output. SexpVal enum (Nil/Bool/Str/Atom/List) plus parse_sexp and sexp_to_str_list helpers used to convert daemon responses.
nodes.languageNotes: Recursive-descent parser over a byte slice with peek/consume primitives.

nodes.name: src/client/symbol_ops.rs
nodes.summary: SymbolOps builders for symbol inspection and schSchemToPinList → schPinListToSymbol generation with safe no-overwrite and temp-symbol cleanup.
nodes.languageNotes: Generates long unwieldy SKILL strings with errset/unwindProtect; uses uuid for temp symbol names.

nodes.name: src/client/whitelist.rs
nodes.summary: evalstring whitelist: blocks dangerous SKILL patterns (system(, sh(, curl, rm -rf, evalstring, etc.) at the CLI before serialization. EvalstringWhitelist supports a sandbox mode that disables evalstring outright.
nodes.languageNotes: Substring + substring-with-allowlist (hiFlush/hiShell) + word-boundary regex matching; case-insensitive.

nodes.name: src/client/window_ops.rs
nodes.summary: WindowOps for window listing and the safe bootstrap interface. BootstrapTarget + BootstrapAction::LoadFile load SKILL programs from a canonicalized scratch dir; raw SKILL execution is forbidden through this path.
nodes.languageNotes: Targets windows by explicit X11-style id; defends against accidental targeting via required expected_name_pattern; path canonicalization enforces scratch-root containment.

nodes.name: src/commands/cell.rs
nodes.summary: CLI command handlers for cell-level operations: open (with mode + dry_run), save, close. Delegates to VirtuosoClient::open_cell_view / save_current_cellview / close_current_cellview.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure JSON-output wrappers; takes CommandContext to share config.

nodes.name: src/commands/library.rs
nodes.summary: CLI command handler for library list; parses ddGetLibList s-expression output via skill_sexp.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses execute_skill_unchecked — capability already enforced at RPC dispatch; calls sexp_to_str_list for output.

nodes.name: src/commands/maestro.rs
nodes.summary: CLI command handlers for Maestro session control: open/close/list_sessions, set_var, run_analysis, sweep, ocean, and staging guard for ADE windows. StagingGuard ensures window stability before simulation.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest module in the batch; mostly JSON-output wrappers calling VirtuosoClient::maestro with shell_quote for path escaping.

nodes.name: src/commands/mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module index for CLI command submodules: cell, config, design, diag, init, library, maestro, process, schema, schematic, session, sim, skill, symbol, transaction, transport_daemon (native-ssh only), tunnel, window.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure re-exports; transport_daemon gated on `native-ssh` feature.

nodes.name: src/commands/process.rs
nodes.summary: Process corner / DC / AC characterization command handlers (char). Runs Spectre sweeps through the daemon and accumulates data points. OpVals is a small JSON values struct.
nodes.languageNotes: Drives simulator + design commands directly via execute_skill with string_literal escaping.

nodes.name: src/commands/schema.rs
nodes.summary: Static CLI schema dump for the `vcli schema` introspection command. Hardcodes the full command/flag structure as a serde_json Value.
nodes.languageNotes: No I/O; just a static json!() tree keyed by command name.

nodes.name: src/commands/schematic.rs
nodes.summary: CLI command handlers for schematic editing: open/place/wire/delete/property/save. Defines the Orient (R0/R90/.../MYR90) value enum and a YAML-style SchematicSpec parser.
nodes.languageNotes: Spec types (SchematicSpec/SpecTarget/SpecInstance/SpecConnection/SpecGlobal/SpecPin) support declarative schematic editing via YAML.

nodes.name: src/commands/symbol.rs
nodes.summary: CLI command handlers for symbol inspection (from SKILL s-expression JSON) and generation (delegates to SymbolOps::generate).
nodes.languageNotes: Tag-based JSON response (success/notFound/failed); uses parse_sexp for response decoding.

nodes.name: src/commands/transaction.rs
nodes.summary: CLI command handlers for Virtuoso transactions: begin, commit, rollback, diff, status. Thin wrappers around VirtuosoClient::tx_* methods.
nodes.languageNotes: All take &CommandContext; tx_diff/tx_status return Option to signal no active transaction.

nodes.name: src/version.rs
nodes.summary: VirtuosoVersion enum (IC23/IC25/Unknown) and detect_version() that probes the daemon via getVersion(t) and parse_ic_version().
nodes.languageNotes: detect_version uses execute_skill_idempotent_probe so it survives a stale queued ticket.
